Done. Here's what was delivered:

**Committed: `b574957` — `docs/competitor-ui-research.md`** (395 lines)

Researched 4 competitors across 8 feature areas using Firecrawl scrapes of their actual product pages, help centers, and YouTube content:

| Feature Area | Competitor Benchmarked | Key Finding |
|---|---|---|
| Storm Map | HailTrace | They have a storm gallery/catalog page; we need a storm archive route |
| Pipeline/CRM | JobNimbus + HailTrace | Both show deal values + revenue totals per stage; our cards are bare |
| Estimates | RoofLink + JobNimbus | RoofLink's Good/Better/Best model is a proven close-rate booster |
| Content/Marketing | Rooftops.ai | Pivoted to AI Roof Reports; we should bundle existing free data into reports |
| Work Orders | RoofLink | Photo verification gates payment; our photo upload is still a stub |
| Dashboard | HailTrace + JobNimbus | Period-over-period % change + drill-down navigation |
| Communication | JobNimbus | SMS/phone features are expensive; focus on email + public status pages |
| Payments | JobNimbus + RoofLink | Invoice payment reminders are free to implement and high impact |

**Top 3 quick wins:** Pipeline deal values (low effort), dashboard drill-down (low effort), invoice payment reminders (low effort).
